note: Anthropic API list rates per million tokens, read from the official pricing page on 2026-10-10; model ids from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview. Base input and output only: prompt-caching multipliers (they vary by model: cache reads are 0.025x base input on Claude Fable 5.1, 0.05x on Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5, 0.1x elsewhere), the 50% Batch API discount, data-residency multipliers and long-context rates all stack on top and are NOT encoded here. Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced at its rate for prompts up to 100,000 tokens; prompts over 100,000 tokens cost 0.50/2.50 per million. Operators on enterprise / annual contracts should override with their own rate card. Supersedes anthropic_pricing_2026_09.json, which is kept as history and lacked the Claude 5.5 / 5.1 lineup (claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5); every rate it does list is unchanged.
